reviews.text: I take my little dog Nellie to see Stephanie every 6-7 weeks for her groom. Stephanie is always so friendly, and although my dog has a nervous temperament, I know she's very well looked after and always comes out looking and smelling amazing! I've tried other places in the past, but Stephanie is definitely the best, so we will absolutely be sticking with her!

My dog labradoodle Sherlock always smells good & looks beautifully evenly groomed.
I would strongly recommend.
Steph is absolutely amazing! Oscar always comes out smelling like a dream. Her customer service is incredible and I couldn’t recommend her enough❤️

First time I’ve dropped my puppy off and left him so felt a little apprehensive. Stephanie was really warm and welcome, Fozzie instantly liked her. Cut is lovely, perfect shape on his face and exactly what I described. Will definitely be returning!

I have been taking my dog, Maple, to Groom47 for over 3 years now and wouldn't go anywhere else. Steph provides a friendly and professional service, and Maple always comes out smelling and looking amazing! Highly recommend 😊 …
